query: symptom checker app triage urgency advice accuracy vignettes real patients emergency
gradeRationale: Certainty will come from appraisal of the retrieved records, not from these leads.
synthesis: Four further studies are suggested as leads to check alongside the six retrieved records: a population analysis of emergency attendance, a comparison of regulatory approaches, a study in older adults and a study of user trust.

items.title: Symptom checker use and emergency department attendance: a population analysis
items.keyFindings: Regions with higher app use showed no change in emergency department attendance after two years.

items.title: Regulating digital triage tools: a comparison of three jurisdictions
items.keyFindings: Only one of three jurisdictions required real-patient validation before endorsement.

items.title: Clinician triage versus app advice in adults aged over 75
items.source: Journal of Ageing and Digital Care
items.keyFindings: App advice matched clinician triage for 48 percent of adults over 75.

items.title: Why users trust or ignore symptom checker advice: a qualitative study
items.keyFindings: Users followed advice that matched their own expectation and ignored advice to stay at home when worried.

summary: Four leads suggested; certainty left to the appraisal.
